name: A-7T
description: "This is a speaker system in which the design of A-7 has been changed to a tall boy type.The A-7T uses a tall boy type to easily install the A-7 at a height suitable for listening.However, the total volume of the enclosure is not taken as an internal volume, and the enclosure is designed as an integrated speaker stand with the enclosure extended to the floor. name: SCM50SL
description: "This is a sl series speaker system using a super linear woofer.The SCM50sl is a unit configuration of the SCM100sl in which only the woofer has a smaller diameter.In the sl series, attention is paid to eddy current strain, which is generated between the front plate and pole piece when the voice coil vibrates repeatedly when a signal is sent to the voice coil. This strain interferes with the linearity of the voice coil.In the sl series, a newly developed material, super linear magnetic material, is used for this part. This material was developed in cooperation with a leading manufacturer in the field of magnetic materials. It retains the current equivalent to that of soft iron, but it also becomes an insulator. This material is processed into an eddy current ring, which is attached to the gap formed by the pole piece and the front plate to effectively eliminate eddy current.The gap between the two eddy current rings is designed to be narrow to cool the voice coil and maintain the dynamic range.A 9 inch cone type woofer is installed in the low range.Pulp cone is used for the diaphragm. The diameter of this unit is smaller than that of the woofer used in SCM100sl, but the magnetic circuit is the same design.The mid-range features a 3 inch soft dome mid-range.A 1 inch soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.Polyester dome is used for the diaphragm.The crossover frequencies of the network section are 380 Hz and 3.5 kHz.This is 440 Hz in the middle of the piano keyboard, which is the center frequency of music, and 380 Hz to 3.5 kHz is allocated to the mid-range with excellent response to gain sound quality benefits.This network circuit is contained in a separate box to prevent modulation due to pressure changes and vibration inside the enclosure.The enclosure is made of high-density MDF material with sufficient thickness. In addition, position of the reinforcement material is determined by many prototypes to suppress resonance.The exterior has a walnut finish, and the rear RUNNET is made of materials with good sound transmission.Steel stand is included."

name: SCA2
description: "A control amplifier designed with ATC unique approach and methodology.The SCA2 uses basically simple single-stage amplification to minimize the phase shift in the ultra-high band and to realize a circuit with less influence on the audible band, thereby achieving high power, high gain, and low distortion in the ultra-wide band.All amplifier stages are of discrete configuration using bipolar transistor and FET with constant voltage drive.The input stage is a cascode-connected FET with a pure complimentary service long tail pair configuration using low-noise bipolar transistors. The output of the current mirror is transmitted to the buffer stage of the complimentary service Darlington transistor.High-quality parts such as high-precision rotary attenuators and gas-sealed, plated relays for input / output terminals are used to suppress signal degradation.The tape buffer circuit is mounted on a single circuit board, the board layout is designed to prevent cross-talk between channels, and the local power supply for each gain stage provides a stable and high quality power supply.Equipped with 2 balanced inputs and 1 output.It uses space technology grade stainless steel and shot-blasted aluminum.A dedicated remote controller, SCA R, is included.This remote control is designed to enhance operability by using a pair of control amplifier SCA2 and power amplifier SPA150.As an option sold separately, there was a dedicated phono equalizer amplifier unit SPH2 of the built-in on-board unit type.This circuit is compatible with MC/MM type cartridges. It is a passive / active type circuit using capacitors patented by ATC and equipped with left and right independent power supplies.In addition, load impedance and capacitance can be set by the DIP switch on the board."
